tldr: Mercury in the 3rd house: thinking becomes personal through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
body:
With Mercury in the 3rd house, this part of you works through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the conversations, questions, messages, errands, and local patterns that shape how you make sense of life.

When this placement is supported, your words and observations can become more useful and easier to trust. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, your attention can scatter, or the same thought can loop without becoming a clear choice. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around communication, learning, siblings, neighbors, and daily movement.
